#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import sys

def main():
    # Execute the environment check script
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "/root/agi-agent/tools/check_env.py"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    # Print stdout and stderr for visibility
    print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr:
        print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
